component.name: Mote
component.summary: Connect to Linux desktops over RDP

description.p: Mote is a remote desktop client for GNOME, for Linux machines that run an RDP server: GNOME Remote Desktop, including its Remote Login, xrdp and KRdp.

ul.li: Connections kept in groups, with their passwords in the keyring, and brought in from .rdp files and Remmina
The remote desktop at the screen's own scale, fractional scales included, resized with the window, on one monitor or on all of them
H.264 and RemoteFX through the graphics pipeline
The clipboard in both directions, with text, pictures and files
Sound, the microphone and a shared folder
SSH tunnels, RD Gateway, Wake-on-LAN, and reconnecting after the network drops
The keyboard's shortcuts going to the session, view-only mode and screenshots

screenshot.caption: A session beside the saved connections

description.p: The clipboard is shared only when turned on, and copied files only when allowed; GNOME Desktop Sharing gets advice on resizing; the Flatpak shares its data with the other installs.
The first stable release, for Linux machines that run GNOME Remote Desktop, xrdp or KRdp.
